profile.headline: Software Engineer Staff
profile.summary: A senior software engineer with 8+ years of experience specializing in building and leading diverse development teams throughout all phases of SDLC. A strong history of developing innovative application features and software solutions to enhance the user experience. Adept at coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to retire homegrown system and execute enterprise technology projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer Stf
positions.description:
• Serve as the technical project lead and Architect to design and implement critical software solutions to allow for a more seamless manufacturing execution in the shop. 
• Participated in a enterprise project to retire homegrown systems and implement existing functionality into Apriso. 
• Designed front end development using a combination of APRISO library, Jscript, Html and CSS.
• Built the back end validation logic using C#, C++, and SQL to retrieve or update the data.
• Proficient in developing and optimizing complex queries, store procedures, views, and scripts.

positions.title: Software Engineer Sr
positions.description:
• Serve as the technical project lead to design and implement critical software solutions to allow for a more seamless manufacturing execution in the shop. 
• Built solutions to send data to the Data Lake server using REST API’s thus allowing for more efficient analytics.  
• Designed front end development using a combination of APRISO library, Jscript, Html and CSS.
• Built the back end validation logic using C#, C++, and SQL to retrieve or update the data.
• Proficient in developing and optimizing complex queries, store procedures, views, and scripts.
• Modified XML schemas to add new data needed to get send through a message broker such as Biztalk and TIBCO to an external system.
• Participate in software upgrades and Disaster recovery exercises for multiple applications.

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented new features in order to retire an older MES system and replace it with the current one.
• Use C# to create a function that will parse needed data out of 2D barcodes. Thus allowing for more error proofing by scanning a barcode vs user inputting data. 
• Create new functionality using the DELMIA tool to retire qualities homegrown system use to track corrective action items. 
• Create complex SQL scripts to get data from homegrown databases and import them into the new database for a smooth cutover transition between systems.
• Support disaster recovery exercise perform yearly.

positions.title: Cell Phone Technician
positions.description:
•Replace Internal Cell phone parts such as: Charging Ports, Screen LCD, Screen Glass, Buttons, and Antennas. 
•Repair Software on cell phones such as: Brick phones, Restore Software, Unlocking, Restoring Original Serial.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
SENIOR DESIGN PROJECT
•Industrial 3D RGB-D Camera Sensor: Design an industrial quality 3D sensor using the R200 Camera, which combines the color feed with 3D depth from the chipset. It can be mounted to an industrial robotic arm and allow it to determine where to grab objects from.
